newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek wins shareholder approval to sue miscreants.
newsitem.headline: Sidek wins shareholder approval to sue miscreants.

text.p: Debt-ridden steel giant Grupo Sidek said it won authorisation from shareholders to take to court any company officials suspected of "irregularities" in its tourism unit Situr.
It said in a communique that the decision was taken at the firm's general assembly on Tuesday.
In March, Sidek said it had unearthed during an audit some possible irregularities in Situr's past, such as the purchase of properties that were unfavourable to the company.
Shareholders after Tuesday's assembly told Reuters they were disappointed that the company gave no further explanation of any wrongdoing, nor did it present any solutions to the firm's debt problems.
Situr B shares fell heavily on the Mexican stock market on Tuesday, losing one centavo to 0.24 pesos.
